attack_relevance_tier.derivation: attack_related if is_attack_related is truthy; otherwise error_or_hv when semantic_type in {error_exception, db_query, generic_runtime_log}; otherwise background

dropped_top_level_fields.name: link_features
dropped_top_level_fields.reason: Attachment-judgement details are not required by the model-facing record. The public attachment decision fields remain available.

dropped_inner_event_fields_unconditional.name: event.record_mode
dropped_inner_event_fields_unconditional.reason: The outer attachment record_mode identifies the record representation used by consumers.

dropped_inner_event_fields_when_redundan.name: event.proc
dropped_inner_event_fields_when_redundan.reason: Repeated process attributes are omitted when the corresponding event attributes are identical; differing or unknown values remain available.

dropped_inner_event_fields_when_redundan.name: event.fd
dropped_inner_event_fields_when_redundan.reason: Repeated file-descriptor attributes are omitted when the corresponding event attributes are identical; differing or unknown values remain available.

dropped_top_level_fields.name: attach_basis
dropped_top_level_fields.reason: Traffic attachment metadata duplicates normalized connection, timing, and sequence information already represented in the public record.

dropped_top_level_fields.name: frame_range
dropped_top_level_fields.reason: Packet-capture frame indices are not required for interpreting the public flow record.

dropped_top_level_fields.name: network_node_ids
dropped_top_level_fields.reason: Parser-internal graph node identifiers are not part of the public flow record.

dropped_top_level_fields.name: nat_alias_used
dropped_top_level_fields.reason: The normalized connection key is the public representation after address normalization.

direction_counts_policy.rule: Drop `reverse` iff its value is 0 (unidirectional flow summary); keep the `forward` key.
